decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to the core hardware portfolio in a growing firm and industry, it is likely to be retained because performance can still be judged as promising enough relative to aspirations and the firm has slack to continue learning.

This software module strongly fits the firm's digitalization and traceability direction and should be cheap to carry alongside existing systems, so behavioral-theory logic points to keeping it while demand information accumulates.

Although it serves a more specific application niche, it still builds directly on the established coding business, and a large innovative firm would usually continue it for another year unless results clearly fell below aspiration levels.
